title: Charta lusoria
shelf_note: No tradition or collection is assigned (catalog_metadata.collections empty), so there is no shelf to contradict; a 1588 Amman playing-card book is plausible for the library. Only the cover was seen, so the title itself cannot be checked against this page.
structure_note: Counts disagree: structure.pages_translated is 0, but pages_translated_field is 103, and this page carries a translation. That looks like an instrument problem (E2), not missing English. 4 backsteps and 4 repeats among only 62 printed numbers: in a woodcut book with little letterpress these are more likely misread or mis-tagged numerals (O11) than a scan splice, but one cover page cannot confirm that.
